data.title: Farm Book Detective
data.description: Let us explore a fun book about a day at the farm!

books.author: Sam Reed
books.coverImagePrompt: A bright red barn with a green tractor parked outside under a blue sunny sky.
books.coverImageAlt: A bright red barn stands near a green tractor.

pages.heading: Big Barn
paragraphs: The red barn stands tall in the sun. A brown horse rests inside.
Soft hay sits on the wooden floor for him to eat.
pages.imagePrompt: A brown horse standing inside a large red barn eating yellow hay from a wooden bin.
pages.imageAlt: A brown horse eats yellow hay inside a barn.
pages.caption: Horse and hay

focusWords.definition: A large animal with four legs and a long tail.
focusWords.pictureCue: Look for the brown animal standing inside the barn.

focusWords.definition: Dried grass that farm animals eat.
focusWords.pictureCue: Look at the yellow grass piled up for food.

pages.heading: Green Fields
paragraphs: Green grass grows all across the wide open hill. A black cow walks slowly by.
Fresh milk comes from this gentle farm animal each day.
pages.imagePrompt: A black and white cow standing in a green grassy field eating grass.
pages.imageAlt: A cow stands in a green field.
pages.caption: Cow in field

focusWords.definition: A large farm animal that gives us milk.
focusWords.pictureCue: Find the black and white animal on the grass.

focusWords.definition: A white drink that comes from cows.
focusWords.pictureCue: Think about the healthy drink the animal helps make.

pages.heading: Busy Coop
paragraphs: Little red hens cluck softly near the wooden fence. A white hen finds a round egg.
Warm feathers keep the birds cozy all day long.
pages.imagePrompt: A red hen sitting in a nest with a white egg next to a wooden fence.
pages.imageAlt: A hen sits near a white egg by a fence.
pages.caption: Hen and egg

focusWords.definition: A female chicken that can lay eggs.
focusWords.pictureCue: See the red bird sitting near the nest.

focusWords.definition: A round shell with food inside laid by birds.
focusWords.pictureCue: Look at the small white oval next to the bird.

challenges.prompt: Tap the title on the cover.
challenges.hint: Look for the biggest words that tell what the whole book is about.

challenges.prompt: Tap the author name on the cover.
challenges.hint: Look near the title for the name of the person who wrote the book.

challenges.prompt: Tap the heading at the start of this page.
challenges.hint: A heading sits above the facts and tells the page topic.

challenges.prompt: Tap the caption for this picture.
challenges.hint: A caption is the short line closest to the picture.
Look near an outer edge for the small number that marks this page.
